mapper.insert: insert into post_likes (post_id, user_id, created_at) values (#{postId}, #{userId}, now())
insert into post_favorites (post_id, user_id, created_at) values (#{postId}, #{userId}, now())
mapper.update: update posts set like_count = like_count + 1 where id = #{postId} and status = 1
update posts set favorite_count = favorite_count + 1 where id = #{postId} and status = 1
mapper.select: select count(*) from posts where id = #{postId} and status = 1
select count(*) from post_likes where post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from post_favorites where post_id = #{postId} and user_id = #{userId}
